about_the_game:
In a remote medieval village, there lived a little pig named Piggy, who dreamed of a juicy apple hidden in the depths of an old barn. But the path to it turned out to be full of challenges: treacherous farmers set traps, enemies are waiting around the corner, and heavy boxes and sharp saws are guarding the cherished fruit. Piggy, though brave, needs your help to pave the way to the apple and then safely return home to the finish line. Can you guide her through all the dangers?

The task is simple, moving the boxes, guide the pig to the apple, and then to the finish line. It sounds simple, but be prepared for difficulties. You will have to build difficult paths so that the pig gets there in one piece. Protect her from enemies and sharp saws. Do not let her fall down from the platform and do not crush the block you are holding! Remember, you are not able to transfer all the blocks. Some do not move and are an obstacle. Think over the path in advance and you will succeed!

  • Dynamic gameplay

  • Interesting puzzles

  • An exciting gameplay
